answers.reason: Full professors hold chairs and represent the highest academic rank, making them eligible for the central academic senate.
University-wide budget allocation is a central administrative and leadership function above the rank of a faculty professor.
Full professors have the rank and office required to serve on committees selecting candidates for vacant professorships.
As a chairholder in the faculty, the full professor is a core member entitled to participate in the faculty council.
Full professors teach and hold a higher rank that permits participation in faculty-level teaching bodies.
Full professors hold a senior academic rank in the faculty and are eligible to sit on the faculty's examination board.
As a research group leader and chairholder in the faculty, the full professor is eligible to take part in awarding internal faculty research grants.
Because those with a higher office and rank may take part in bodies below their level, a full professor may join this teaching working group.
A full professor's rank in teaching and research allows participation in lower-level decisions like teaching laboratory procurement.
Under the rule that higher rank permits participation in bodies below one's level, a full professor is permitted to take part in faculty orientation planning.
